oneLiner: Web app that creates a week‑long meal plan using ingredients you already have in your fridge.
problem: Home cooks waste time and food because they lack a quick way to turn existing fridge contents into balanced weekly meals.
targetUser: Busy adults and families who want to reduce food waste and simplify dinner decisions.
coreFlow: Generate a 7‑day meal plan using available ingredients
Export a grocery list for missing items

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of current inventory, upcoming meals, and quick actions.

screens.name: Inventory Input
screens.purpose: Add, edit, or remove fridge items via manual entry or CSV upload.

screens.name: Meal Plan
screens.purpose: Display the generated weekly menu with recipe links and ingredient usage.

screens.name: Meal Detail
screens.purpose: Show step‑by‑step recipe, highlight which ingredients are already on hand, and allow swaps.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configure dietary filters, portion sizes, and export preferences.

outOfScope: AI‑powered image recognition for automatic inventory capture
Social sharing or community recipe ratings
Advanced nutritional analytics beyond basic macro summary
